name: MCB 3845W
title: Microbial Diversity, Ecology and Evolution
description: Readings from the scientific literature will provide a focus for investigating the mechanisms and strategies for the exchange of genetic information, as well as the impact of gene transfer on environmental adaptation and evolution.
requirement_description: BIOL 1107; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: MCB 2610.
